title: Will the bucket absorb this burst?
description: Select a traffic shape, then tune arrival rate, duration, refill, and stored burst credit. Every admitted request consumes one token; no latency or throughput benchmark is implied.

profiles.label: Reconnect burst
profiles.detail: Clients reconnect together and briefly exceed the normal request rate.

profiles.label: Steady client
profiles.detail: Arrival remains below refill, so the bucket recovers after each tick.

profiles.label: Webhook recovery
profiles.detail: A downstream recovery releases queued deliveries faster than the sustainable rate.
